risk_note: F1-08bd (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 ②, D10-1712, D10-1816, D10-1863; landed per D10-1772, stacked on #203 F1-08bc and rebased onto main). Payout queue pause controls for switch.payout or switch.all: 暂停队列 / 解除暂停 by the overview state and 解除通道暂停 for a paused channel, confirm, SMS step-up, adminUpdateKillSwitch with expected_version; an unknown write result is retried only with the original key and body (D10-1731). Frozen cases (same as D10-1733): F1-08ba READONLY#1 and F1-08bb ACCESS#1 only change the super-admin write-entry list to exactly the landed entries (modify_existing, ledger #212); per D10-1816 each of the two files gets one new it block ([AC-F1-08bd-FROZEN#1]/[#2]). The rule tests were written by independent Claude contexts (ledger tester claude-independent; ops/approvals.yaml #36 at the time) in two rounds; spec-test r1 pass, r2 (new blocks only) pass. Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context, r1 plus an r2 fix); couli-ci verify:fast and --browser green after the rebase and the new blocks. Written by hand.
